column2: [intro]
In my head, it’s running full throttle,
I’ve got a memory that’s like a model.
I remember everything, it’s quite a feat,
Even trivial details, it’s hard to beat.
I have a visual memory, it’s truly great,
I recall every detail, it’s like fate.
Faces, places, and moments so dear,
Nothing escapes me, my memory's clear.
I see someone on the street,
I recall having met, it's a treat.
I say, "We met yesterday at the café,"
They look puzzled, I’ve led them astray.
I have a visual memory, it’s truly great,
I recall every detail, it’s like fate.
Faces, places, and moments so dear,
Nothing escapes me, my memory's clear.
[ solo ]
So if you want to remember all that’s fine,
Open your eyes wide, like a bird in flight.
Visual memory is a treasure so bright,
And together, we’ll remember it day and night.
[outro]
